verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. In both, the red T's stem stops about 64% of the way down instead of reaching the bottom edge as it does in the original. That leaves the bottom third as empty blue and turns the bleeding T motif into a floating shape. All the copy is crammed into the top 35% and the 'CRUELTY' line straddles the stem edge, so the layout is top-heavy with a large dead area.
